verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: vendor-defined monitors, a fixed daily repository scan, a CI check, Fieldwork evidence collection on a schedule (a recurring schedule, not an event trigger), and status-page email notifications. The API and MCP server are developer building blocks a user could build automation on, not a native rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
